bugClass.title: Browser actions target a disabled local store
bugClass.cause: A feature reads from or writes to a local snapshot or Hub-backed API even though production state is served through a linked remote connection and the local snapshot endpoint is disabled. The UI can display remote data while actions against the local store fail or appear missing.
bugClass.criteria: Match when a browser-facing read or write depends on a local snapshot or Hub API that is disabled or unavailable in production, while the feature's data is sourced through a separate remote connection. Either an action is routed to the local store instead of the remote service, or a read checks the local store instead of the remote source; either path can independently cause the failure.

candidates.evidence: The excerpt only imports `parseHomePayload` from the `/api/hub-home` route; it shows no browser-facing call, local-store dependency, remote data source, or disabled endpoint.

Lines 172–184 show browser UI code calling `/api/hub-home/agents` and reading chat receipts through `api.get`, but no evidence here identifies whether those routes use a disabled local store or the linked remote connection.
